promise: Seek approval for a 36-month, approximately $1.9 billion EFF programme for Bolivia
description: IMF staff reached agreement with Bolivia on July 29, 2026. Subsequent Bolivian approval did not substitute for IMF Executive Board authorization, which remained pending in September reporting.
evidence: Staff-level agreement announced July 29, 2026; board approval still pending

review.note: Staff agreement is conditional on Board approval; AP's September 2026 report says that approval still pending despite Bolivian legislative action. Thirty-six months should not be counted from staff announcement to invent a July 2029 expiry.

promise: Extend the Benazir Nashonuma Programme for three years to protect an additional 3.3 million children and women from malnutrition across Pakistan
description: On July9,2026, BISP and UN partners announced a three-year programme extension targeting another3.3 million pregnant or breastfeeding women and children under two. Expected total reach is8 million; these are targets, not already delivered outcomes.
evidence: Joint announcement on July 9, 2026 of the three-year extension
Extension targets an additional 3.3 million children and women

review.note: Event dateline July9 is distinct from WFP page publication July10. Beneficiary groups, additional3.3m and expected cumulative8m supported. Three-year extension does not establish exact July31,2029 closing date; start/end programme dates need agreement.
